lessons: Review approved the rest of the diff and every mechanical check passed. Keep the current branch and fix only the three new review findings. Do not redesign.

In Runner.reject, a committed ticket whose frontmatter will not parse gets past the parse try/except, then stamp() raises after the reject signal and the to:rejected transition are already journaled. Check stampability before any journal write.

When the ticket cannot be stamped, treat it like the dirless ghost: journal-only, skip the stamp commit, and still run the dead-dependency handling. Test it in tests/test_verbs.py: exit 0, the reject signal, the transition, and the dependent reports and box messages.

Add a tests/test_verbs.py test for the nothing-to-confirm rule: a committed state: confirmed ticket with an intake signal and no state_transition. `squatch confirm <stem>` must exit 2 with the refusal message and leave the journal unchanged.

Add a tests/test_drain.py test for the spent-retry road: a stem parked gate_failed with its retry cap spent (for example config caps {retry: 0} or enough journaled draws). Assert the parked line contains `retry cap spent` and `squatch confirm <stem>`.
Scope in says every rule gets a test. Before finishing, go through each Scope in clause and match it to an asserting test, so review does not find another missing one.
reason: Review found three fixable issues: a crash before the dead-dependency handling in reject on an unstampable ticket, and two Scope in rules with no test. The findings name the exact fixes, so a retry at the same capability should clear them.
